data.description: Detached unsaved payload, including its declared stable identity and case discriminator.

target.description: Opaque stable correlation token; applications never construct it.

totalDocs.description: Exact number of matching documents; omitted when the list set pagination=false.

totalPages.description: Number of pages at this limit; omitted when the list set pagination=false.

locale.description: Exact content locale addressed by the issue; never a fallback locale.

target.description: Opaque occurrence identity for correlating field issues across repeated rows.
